headline: A 1-for-4 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-3 on the top plays · Season: 47-202

entries.headline: Cal Raleigh connected
entries.story: Cal Raleigh cashed. Facing Jose Quintana, he went deep in the 1st in his 1st at bat. The call: "Cal Raleigh homers (23) on a fly ball to left center field. Dominic Canzone scores." Final line: 2-for-4.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber came close
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 1-for-4 with 1 BB against Christian Scott and the New York Mets. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Kyle Schwarber doubles (18) on a line drive to left fielder Juan Soto." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Seiya Suzuki stayed in the yard
entries.story: Seiya Suzuki went 2-for-3 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Nick Lodolo and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Sal Stewart stayed in the yard
entries.story: Sal Stewart went 0-for-4 against Matthew Boyd and the Chicago Cubs. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
